name: Header
description: The store's top bar: an optional info strip, brand, primary links with optional mega-menus, search, saved items, cart and one call to action.

fields.name: Variant
fields.helpText: default: brand, inline links and actions. centered: brand centred with links on a second row. minimal: brand, search, cart and a Menu button at every width.

fields.name: Brand
fields.helpText: Shown as the wordmark when no logo is set. Keep it under 20 characters — it never wraps.

fields.name: Logo
fields.helpText: SVG, PNG or WebP of any shape. Replaces the wordmark. Sized by height (2.25rem, 2rem on phones) and capped at 15rem wide, so a wide logo gets smaller rather than crowding the bar. A logo wider than 4:1 with no mark shows the store name instead on small phones.

fields.name: Square mark
fields.helpText: Optional square symbol (an initial, a monogram). Shown beside the wordmark when there is no logo, and in place of the logo or wordmark on phones narrower than 400px.

fields.name: Links
fields.helpText: Primary links. 3 to 6 recommended; more than 6 may overflow at 64–80rem. Give a link a panel to turn it into a mega-menu: up to 4 columns, each with a heading, its links and a See all link. A column can hold up to 2 product or collection cards, a picture with a title and a price.

fields.name: Phone menu layout
fields.helpText: How the Menu drawer shows a link's panel. accordion (default): each panel folds into a row that opens. sections: every panel listed open under its heading.

fields.name: Account link
fields.helpText: Where the Account button goes. Leave empty to hide the button.

fields.name: Search style
fields.helpText: icon: a labelled Search button. field: a "Search the shop" pill from 80rem, the Search button below. inline: a live search bar in the bar, centered variant only, from 68.8rem only.

fields.name: Transparent over hero
fields.helpText: Only takes effect when the next block is a Hero with the image-background variant.

fields.name: Info strip
fields.helpText: A thin strip above the bar: delivery, returns and opening hours at the start, help links and a phone number at the end. Up to 3 per side. Empty hides the strip. Phones show only the first item.

fields.name: Icon
fields.helpText: For example truck, arrow-back-up or clock.

fields.name: Link URL
fields.helpText: Optional. A page path, a full URL or tel:/mailto:.

fields.name: Side
fields.helpText: start (default) or end of the strip.
